The Bambino® Plus pairs a 54mm stainless steel portafilter and 18g dose with a hands-free automatic steam wand that textures microfoam milk for you, and its ThermoJet® heating system is ready in 3 seconds. Key Features: • 4 keys formula used in professional café machines • Low-pressure pre-infusion then 9 bar extraction (15 bar Italian pump) • ThermoJet® heating – ready in 3 seconds • One-touch 1-shot / 2-shot volumetric control and steam • Automatic hands-free microfoam: 3 milk temperatures and 3 texture levels, plus manual mode • 54mm portafilter with dual & single wall filters, 18g dose • PID temperature control • BILT® 3D interactive setup guide Product Dimensions: • Dimensions (W x D x H): 19.5 x 32 x 31 cm • Weight: 6.7 kg • Capacity: 1.9 L water tank; 480 ml milk jug
